name: review-build-finding
description: A confirmed defect on a completed build-path phase becomes a backlog item and nothing else: review closes a phase and never reopens one, so it opens no R… rework event, moves no Scope or Exit row, and never reaches `mano stories` or `mano dev` — which would give the phase the second ledger the projection refuses (B6, 1.6.1).

steps.prompt: the release stage is wrong — requiring src/release-stage.js should return base+feature+release but the label drops the feature part
